title: 🚨 YOU’RE NOT “STRUGGLING”… YOU’RE SPLIT.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOU’RE NOT “STRUGGLING”… YOU’RE SPLIT.

You keep saying:
“I just need more discipline…”
But that’s not the real problem.
There are two versions of you fighting for control.

One wants God.
The other keeps going back to what God is trying to free you from.
And the truth?
👉 You can’t become who God called you to be… while protecting who He told you to crucify.
“The War Between Who You Are and Who You Want to Be”
This is not another motivational read.
This is a confrontation.

A spiritual wake-up call for believers who are tired of:
• repeating the same sins
• losing private battles
• feeling like two different people
This book will expose the war inside you—and show you how to actually win it.
🔥 WHAT YOU’LL DISCOVER INSIDE:

• Why you feel divided even though you love God
• The dangerous lie behind “this is just who I am”
• How to break agreement with your old identity
• What it really means to be crucified with Christ
• How to renew your mind and rewire your patterns
• The daily habits that starve the flesh and strengthen the Spirit
⚔️ REAL TALK:

Most people:
• Manage sin
• Excuse patterns
• Stay stuck in cycles

Few people:
• Kill the old self
• Walk in true identity
• Live in real freedom

Most want change.
Few choose surrender.
🔒 THIS IS NOT FOR EVERYONE
A growing vault of hard-hitting, life-changing Christian resources designed for believers who are serious about transformation.
If you’re casual… scroll.
If you’re ready for war… keep reading.

If you’re done pretending…
If you’re tired of losing the same battle…
If you’re ready to become who God already says you are—
Step into your real identity.
💬 ENGAGE & ACT
